title: The sand dollar on the pin
logline: The sand dollar from the 2020 Sunday on the corkboard, close, on its pin, a hairline crack across it. Eleven months before it moves to the sill. The page draws the crack.

panels.composition: Close on a small sand dollar pinned to a corkboard with a single pushpin through its center hole, a hairline crack across it, the corkboard's other items blurred around.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on a small sand dollar pinned to a corkboard by a pushpin through its center with a hairline crack across it, other pinned items blurred around it, no words legible
image.notes: Moves to the sill at ro_2025-01-05.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
